messages:
natalie: FYI ran mizar-v1 onboarding (quant=q4b) against multilang.translate_smoke. Seeing consistent bracket/glyph flips around mixed-script tokens (CJK + ASCII weekdays) and some bracket swaps in RTL locales. Posting minimal repros and a short reproduction command.

haroon: paste the command + one example please.

natalie: command:
```
./scripts/onboard_eval --model mizar-v1 --quant q4b --suite multilang:translate_smoke --locales zh-CN,zh-HK,he-IL,ar-SA --out /tmp/mizar_q4b_smoke.jsonl
```

natalie: sample zh-HK:
- src: "\u7d50\u675f 5/18 (\u661f)"
- ref: "Ends 5/18 (Sat)"
- mizar-q4b: "Ends 5/18 \uff09Sat\uff08"  <-- fullwidth parens appear and order looks swapped

iesha: sample he-IL?

natalie: he sample:
- src: "(\u05d0\u05d5\u05dc) 11/11"
- ref: "(Place) 11/11"
- mizar-q4b: "(\u05d0\u05d5\u05dc] 11/11"  <-- closing paren becomes ']'

haroon: can you dump the tokenizer tokens for these inputs (pre-infer) and the detok stream (post-infer)? We need to know whether token boundaries changed.

natalie: quick dumps:
```
# pre-infer tokens: ["\u7d50\u675f"," ","5","/","18"," ","(","\u661f",")"]
# post-detok stream: ["\u7d50\u675f"," ","5","/","18"," ","\uff09","\u661f","\uff08"]
```

haroon: pre-infer tokens are identical to baseline q8 for these samples, so detok/post-normalization looks suspect. Any build info for q4b kernels?

Build-bot: /build meta model=mizar-v1 variant=q4b kernel=kernel_pack_2026-09-12-9f1d NORMALIZER=v2 LINK_ICU=false

iesha: interesting. LINK_ICU=false here, so not ICU-related. Did the normalization pipeline switch to a new mirror-pair table recently?

haroon: grep runtime/normalizers shows a new glyph_pair_canonicalizer in commit 7b2c -> 8d9a that rewrites paired punctuation under certain context heuristics. Might be over-eager for mixed-script adjacency.

natalie: bisect perf: small BLEU delta (-0.14 zh-HK, -0.5 he) across 450 samples vs q8 baseline. Not huge but reproducible and customer-facing.

L10n-bot: /report locale_anomaly model=mizar-v1 quant=q4b suite=multilang.translate_smoke delta_bleu_zhHK=-0.14 delta_bleu_he=-0.50 samples=450

haroon: plan: run a focused detok-only harness with and without the glyph_pair_canonicalizer enabled. If toggling it fixes the symptom, we can disable for the q4b pack and rebuild.

iesha: quick mitigation: add routing override for affected locales to q8 variant until patch lands. snippet applied in console:
{"routing":{"locale_overrides":{"zh-HK":"mizar-v1-q8","he-IL":"mizar-v1-q8"}}}

Triage-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-998 mizar-detok-glyphpair (priority=P2)

natalie: attached artifacts to the incident: token dumps, detok logs, and the minimal detok harness command. I'll follow up with a minimal unit test for mixed-script punctuation adjacency.

haroon: update: minimal detok run shows toggling glyph_pair_canonicalizer=off returns correct parens for all repros. Opening hotfix PR to disable that pass for quant packs pending review.

iesha: if we disable it, add a regression unit test and a note in the quant pack release checklist so pack builders know not to re-enable without an eval.

haroon: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/7823 - sets glyph_pair_canonicalizer=false for q4 builds and adds test. Kicking off smoke CI now.

natalie: thanks. I'll monitor L10n alerts and unroute locales if hotfix is green. Also adding fa-IR to the smoke to check broader RTL scope.

L10n-bot: noted: extended smoke locales to include fa-IR for this model pack

haroon: CI smoke passed on hotfix branch. Preparing kernel pack rebuild; ETA ~2 hours for hotfix rollout. Will keep thread updated.

iesha: once hotfix is rolled, let's run full multilang eval and schedule a postmortem to document the normalization pass behavior.

natalie: agreed. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
